I never thought that would happen to
Shiya. Things are getting interesting,
aren't they?

rows.label: tlk70000059_03_msg0002
rows.name:
When goods move, people move. And
when people move, money moves too.

rows.label: tlk70000059_03_msg0003
rows.name:
Watch things like that closely and you
can start to see what may happen next,
but...

rows.label: tlk70000059_03_msg0004
rows.name:
The place that looks like it's really
about to get exciting is Superbia♪

rows.label: tlk70000059_03_msg0005
rows.name:
I can sense a shrewd ruler's scheme:
mop up the Shiyan remnants quickly and
put down roots all across Gula.
